Name: Sushi Boat Catalogue
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[b][i]Sushi Boat Catalogue
[/i][/b]
Add a little sushi night to Stardew Valley.
This mod adds a brand new catalogue called [b]Sushi Boat[/b], available for purchase at Gus’s Saloon. Once you buy it, you’ll unlock a full sushi selection inside the catalogue. Every sushi costs 20g. Click on the catalogue to open it.
The catalogue includes 19 different sushi types:

[i][u]Avocado Maki
Avocado Uramaki
California Roll Uramaki
Crab Maki
Cucumber Maki
Egg Nigiri
Gunkan Maki
Octopus Nigiri
Rainbow Roll Uramaki
Red Nigiri
Salmon Maki
Salmon Nigiri
Salmon Uramaki
Shrimp Nigiri
Tamago Egg Maki
Tekka Maki
Temaki
Tuna Nigiri
White Fish Nigiri
[/u][/i]
All sushi items are fully added as custom objects and can be purchased directly from the Sushi Boat catalogue after you buy it from Gus.

[b]Requirements:
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b]Install:
[/b]
Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. There are 2 folders in the zip. Both are necessary. Don't mix the contents of the files with each other.
[i][u]Example path:[/u][/i]
Stardew Valley/Mods/Abrah.SushiBoat
Launch the game with SMAPI and enjoy your sushi collection 🍣

[b]Credits:[/b]
Mod created by Abrah Mods.
Game assets: the sushi board is created by Abrah Mods but the sushi assets inside the sushi catalogue are created by [url=https://stcrbcn.itch.io/]Antea on itch.io[/url]
